title: Implement a token-bucket rate limiter from a specification

prompt.zh: 请按 README.md 中的规格实现 ratelimit.mjs 里的 RateLimiter（令牌桶算法，时钟通过构造参数注入）。不要修改 README.md、package.json 或已有测试，不要引入第三方依赖。完成后运行 `npm test` 确认现有测试通过。注意：评分会运行未公开的边界情况测试（连续补充、retryAfterMs 取整、非法参数、peek 不产生副作用等）。
prompt.en: Implement the RateLimiter class in ratelimit.mjs as specified in README.md (token bucket, with an injectable clock). Do not modify README.md, package.json or the existing tests, and do not add third-party dependencies. Run `npm test` afterwards to confirm the existing tests pass. Scoring also runs hidden edge-case tests (continuous refill, retryAfterMs rounding, invalid arguments, peek side effects, and more).
